claims.statement: Official KSeF offline procedures require the invoice to use the current structured format and normally be submitted no later than the next business day after the announced unavailability ends, making queue and reconciliation failures measurable.

Most Polish enterprises entered mandatory KSeF issuance from 1 April 2026, placing the operational cost with the taxpayer and its finance function; willingness to buy a specialized field bridge remains unproven.
The proposed control path is a revocable taxpayer mandate over the field-to-KSeF handoff, with export-only fallback; no mandate or accounting integration has been acquired.

KSeF allows authorized third parties such as accounting offices to act for a taxpayer, showing that delegated workflows exist, though the exact authorization needed for this offer requires legal and technical confirmation.

commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A successfully validated and reconciled invoice is the paid event; measurable losses are office rekeying time, delayed billing, rejection correction, and missed offline submission windows
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: KSeF obligation, first invoice rejection, growing technician count, or accounting overtime caused by field paperwork
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly renewal based on invoice volume and error-rate reporting

contrary_evidence: Generic accounting and invoicing vendors have a natural installed-base advantage and can add the same workflow.
KSeF provides official client tooling and documented offline modes, so many firms may accept a manual workaround.
The smallest firms below the temporary monthly invoiced-sales threshold remain exempt from issuance until 2027, delaying part of the market.

economics.acquisition_route: Accounting-office referrals, field-service integrations, and direct pilots with installation contractors
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Conditional path: 1,200 firms at 399 PLN monthly equals about 5.75m PLN ARR; durable margin and low churn could support a value above 5m PLN, but no demand or CAC evidence exists
economics.founder_time: One narrow trade and export-first integration can fit 3-5 hours daily; multi-package support cannot without help
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription or usage revenue less OCR, storage, transmission, support, partner share, and compliance maintenance
economics.payback: Target under three months if the tool removes recurring office rekeying and shortens days-to-invoice; unmeasured
economics.pricing: Discovery hypothesis: 149-699 PLN monthly by technician and invoice volume, with a metered option at 2-5 PLN per invoice
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every invoice repeats the workflow, but retention collapses if accounting suites solve it natively

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A library of anonymized validation failures, correction patterns, and trade-specific field templates reduces rejection and support rates
fingerprint.customer: Polish installation, maintenance, construction, and mobile-service firms whose invoices originate at customer sites
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accounting-office referrals, trade associations, and integrations with field-service software used by small contractors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Mobile-first invoice evidence capture, offline queue, FA(3) validation, KSeF submission, and accounting reconciliation sold on usage tiers
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The service company pays per successfully reconciled invoice or for a monthly bundle of field-originated invoices
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A field worker finishes a job where connectivity, KSeF credentials, final quantities, or buyer details are not cleanly available

founder_fit: The founder can map error patterns and automate validation with data-science methods
A lawful family-firm test relationship can expose real field-to-office friction without using employer resources
A narrow mobile capture MVP is compatible with an employed founder's time limit
The product has measurable throughput and error outcomes and can scale through accounting partners
risks: Tax or API changes can invalidate workflows quickly
A credential or invoice-data breach would be severe
Accounting incumbents can bundle the feature at negligible incremental price
High-touch onboarding may overwhelm a part-time founder

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: per technician or per reconciled invoice field compliance service
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: authorized conversion of onsite job completion into a ksef transaction
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: continued conformance with ksef authorization fa schema and offline submission rules

structure.commercial_archetype: Usage-priced transaction bridge between field completion and statutory e-invoice submission
structure.control_point: The handoff at which job evidence becomes the canonical invoice record
structure.critical_dependency: Continuing lawful KSeF authentication, schema, offline, and API compatibility

thesis: Observed workflow change: KSeF 2.0 became mandatory for most Polish enterprises in 2026, while official offline procedures still require structured electronic invoices and later submission within prescribed windows. Sell field-service contractors a mobile capture, authorization, queueing, and reconciliation layer that lets a technician finish the commercial handoff onsite without rekeying it later in the office.
title: KSeF Field-Invoice Offline Bridge
uncertainties: Frequency and cost of field-originated KSeF errors after the initial rollout stabilizes
Whether customers will authorize a small vendor to transmit tax documents
Integration scope and rate limits of accounting packages and KSeF interfaces
Extent of professional liability for missed deadlines or malformed invoices
